_comment: Row 759 REFUTE fix (O651): the correctness lens's M7/M8 escaped the first cut -- _do_download could keep the pre-patch outcome (needs_review with the modal open) while every test of _download_from_revealed_modal alone stayed green. The catcher drives the real caller arm and reads the OUTCOME (a download reaches _do_probe_fetch, no needs_review job). Anchors are structural (no value token, no '=') so the row357 anchor gate classifies them STABLE rather than UNKNOWN.
subject: _do_download carries the re-entry's download forward instead of discarding it

mutants.label: 759-M7 the caller treats every re-entry as no download (the dl guard is short-circuited true)
759-M8 the call is kept, its result discarded (the re-entry call is and-ed to nothing)
